facilitator_id.description: Settlement facilitator id. Use evm-base for Base USDC payments.

payment.description: x402 payment proof payload containing resource, amount, wallet, and settlement metadata.

payment_identifier.description: Optional idempotency key. Reuse it on retries to return the cached paid result.

previous_hash.description: Optional previous content hash to compare against the current page.

previous_text.description: Optional previous page text to compare against the current page.

url.description: HTTP URL to fetch and compare for the diff monitor.
